name: Locking the Mac: a real wave the first time, a slight silent one soon after
case: The person locks the Mac, unlocks it two minutes later and locks it again. The first lock in a while gets a real wave with a word and a sign; the unlock and the lock soon after are routine: a slight wave in silence, no sign.
why: MomentRule.bye and hello: a lock an hour or more after the last, or the first, is a real wave, medium; any other lock and every unlock a slight one, small. The rule makes the moment, so no Jev is asked.
